While developing more features of function graph
caused the WARN_ON to trigger in the prepare_ftrace_return function.

column2: it was hard for me to find out that was happening because the
it would just cause a hard lockup or reboot.

column1: The reason is that it is not safe to call printk from this function.

column2: I also found that it calls unregister_ftrace_graph

column1: which grabs a mutex and calls kstop machine. This would definitely
lock the box up if it were to trigger.
This patch adds a fast and safe ftrace_graph_stop() which will
stop the function tracer. Then it is safe to call the WARN ON.
